display_name: AIA An Phuc Tron Doi Uu Viet whole-life universal-life product rules and terms (V082021): definitions, application, temporary insurance, benefits and exclusions, policyholder rights, premium allocation and account value, charges, change, reinstatement and termination, claims, the fund and disputes

run.method: one agent, one session, no sub-agents, from BRIEF.md (work began 2026-10-06 and finished 2026-10-07)

language.note: Identifiers and comments are English (@lang en). Vietnamese is quoted only in `-- src:N |` comments generated by tools/vnsrc.py from line N of the deposited source rendering, and in short runs that tools/vnsrc.py checks occur verbatim in it. The nouns and findings modules cite clauses by line number instead of quoting them.

source.authority: private contract terms published by the insurer; version V082021, approved by Ministry of Finance letter 4281/BTC-QLBH of 04/04/2014 as amended by letters 9971/BTC-QLBH (19/07/2016), 4064/BTC-QLBH (05/04/2019) and 8657/BTC-QLBH (03/08/2021); only the text as amended to 2021 is in the source

aids.use: read for forks tagged LAW; not encoded; the aid stops at Article 130 and does not contain the Law's commencement or transitional provisions

scope: The whole document: Chapters 1 to 9, Articles 1 to 33, every definition and every table (7.2.3, 7.7, 14.5.3, Article 17, Article 32). Coverage table in NOTES.md section 2: 141 rows, 127 encoded, 14 inert (the cover and contents, 1.5, 1.27, Article 3, 14.1, 14.3, 14.6, 14.7, the chapeau of Article 22, 27.3, 27.4, Articles 30 and 31), none out of scope or deferred. Inputs, never defaults: the sum insured, premiums, account values, debts, cost-of-insurance rates, interest credited, the Company's minimums and maximums from time to time, any published increase of the 10-billion limits. Declined by name (REFUSE): an insurable interest under the Law for an 'other person' (2.2), the 9.3 reduction, a second cancer, a cancer advance larger than the benefit it comes off, payments 14.5 and 1.16 do not place, debts larger than a benefit (6.4, 22.1, 25.1), a negative 23.3 refund, the Article 5 refund on a death by illness, the late-payment interest of Article 29, an unnamed dangerous activity (8.2), and incomplete medical facts (1.29(b), 1.30(c), 1.30(e)).

forks.F1: Maturity: the anniversary strictly after the 100th birthday (Article 4); 1.9 read with 1.32 gives a year later (finding FD1).
forks.F2: 1.2's 18 years are the policyholder's own age, not the insured's insurance age (finding FD2).
forks.F3: 1.3: at least 30 days old and insurance age 65 or less on the effective date, both ends included.
forks.F5: 7.2.3: the overlapping rows are read first-match.
forks.F6: 7.4: the 10-billion limit is a cap, not a condition (LAW, Art. 24; finding FD6).
forks.F7: 7.4: the limit counts accidental-death benefits only.
forks.F8: 7.5: the 25% is of the unreduced sum insured; 7.2.3 applies to a death or disability only.
forks.F10: 7.5: the cancer advance is not deducted from the account value paid on an 8.1-excluded death (finding FD5).
forks.F11: 8.1: an excluded death pays the account value only, with no 7.4.
forks.F12: 1.30(e): all non-melanoma skin cancers, and melanoma under 1.5 mm Breslow or Clark 3, are excluded.
forks.F13: 1.30(ii): the 90 days include the acceptance or reinstatement day; day 90 in, day 91 out.
forks.F14: 15.1: the 60th day after the trigger is the last day of grace; lapsed from the next day (LAW, Art. 37(2)).
forks.F15: 1.16: the annual-mode first-year basic premium is an input.
forks.F16: 14.5 and 1.16: payments the rules do not place are declined.
forks.F17: 16: the monthly deduction comes off the basic account first, the shortfall off the accumulation account (finding FD12).
forks.F18: 16 and 32: interest credited is an input; the rate floor is applied on yearly rates.
forks.F19: 9.3: the amount of the reduction is declined.
forks.F20: 21: the free look runs from the later of issue and receipt (LAW, Art. 35; finding FD13).
forks.F21: 28: twelve calendar months plus days spent on 27.3-27.4 documents; no force-majeure or knowledge rule added (LAW, Art. 30).
forks.F22: 29: 30 days from receipt of the 27.1 or 27.2 file (LAW, Art. 31(1)).
forks.F24: 15.4 protects once the first four years' premiums are paid; a shortfall in years 1-4 is a debt under 1.28.
forks.F25: Every age test on the insured uses the 1.32 insurance age.
forks.F26: 7.7: the last row's numeral (year 6) is taken over its word (five) (finding FD14).
forks.F27: 7.7: the overlapping windows are summed as written (finding FD27).
forks.F28: 14.5.3 and 17 are keyed on the premium year.
forks.F29: Monthiversaries are counted from the effective date each time.
forks.F30: An anniversary of 29 February falls on 28 February in a common year.
forks.F31: 1.6: the effective date is the later of completion and full first payment.
forks.F32: 8.2: innocent beneficiaries keep their 7.4 shares; 8.1 has no such saving (finding FD15).
forks.F34: Article 5: the refund above 100,000,000 replaces the benefit; the end day of temporary cover is covered (finding FD9).
forks.F35: 21: the refund is the premiums paid less medical-examination costs (LAW, Art. 35).
forks.F36: 6.2: the rule returns the remedies open, not the Company's choice.
forks.F37: 6.3: 'in force and alive' is tested at the end of the two years (finding FD3).
forks.F38: 24 and 25.2(d) meet at exactly 24 months without a gap (LAW, Art. 37(3)).
forks.F39: 1.31: a death on day 180 after the accident counts.
forks.F40: 9.1: 80% of the basic account value at the request.
forks.F41: 11.1: a request on day 90 after the marriage or birth counts.
forks.F42: Days, months and years are calendar ones.
forks.F43: Whether Law 08/2022/QH15 governs this 2021 form is not decided; every LAW note is outside knowledge, unverified, as to applicability.
forks.F44: 6.6: the policyholder's remedy is suspension, as written (LAW, Art. 22(3) gives cancellation and refund).
forks.F45: 7.2.1: the insurance age at the date of the disability decides 'before 70'.
forks.F46: 33: an action on the third anniversary of the dispute is in time.
forks.F47: 8.1: the suicide window is 24 months from the later of the effective date and the last reinstatement, last day included (LAW, Art. 40(1)(a)).
forks.F48: 14.5.1(iii): a payment short of the basic premium is held towards it.
forks.F49: 22.4: no consent of the insured is required, as written (LAW, Art. 28(1) requires it).
forks.F50: 27.1: medical evidence and proof of entitlement are needed for every death, disability and cancer claim.
forks.F51: 8.2: 'except to save a life' saves only the unnecessary dangerous act.
forks.F52: 7.7: the contract need not be in force on the bonus date.
forks.F53: 6.1: 'under 18' is measured on the day the application is completed.
forks.F54: 33: 'Bên mua được bảo hiểm' is read as the policyholder or the insured.
forks.F55: 23.3: the insurable age group is that of 1.3, from the true date of birth.
forks.F56: 10.3, 11.4, 12.4, 13.1: 'ngay sau khi' approval means strictly after it.

findings: NOTES.md section 4: 28 findings, FD1 to FD28; 18 are demonstrated by assertions in aptduv-findings.l4, 4 by assertions or refusals in aptduv-tests.l4 (one of them also by a residual trace in aptduv-findings.l4), 6 are reading only.
